description: Gemini calls that ended without an answer after every attempt, by feature, model and error class. A worker who went away (cancelled) or a stream the caller stopped (closed) is not a failure. NF-F0-016.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="nomadfinance-api" AND jsonPayload.message=~"^gemini_call_failed " AND jsonPayload.gemini_usage.outcome="failed"
